V01.drivers: Slender, typical adult proportions; normal shoulder-to-hip taper; legs about half of height; ordinary profile curve.
axial_cues: mild lumbar curve with ordinary buttock projection

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest that tapers smoothly to the pelvis
structure.joint_integration: smooth human transitions at every joint
structure.segment_relations: typical human trunk, leg and arm ratios
structure.load_path: vertical from trunk through hips and straight knees to plantigrade feet

V02.drivers: Ordinary lean human build, slightly broader shoulders than V01.

V03.drivers: Ordinary human with a slightly soft, rounded belly in profile.

structure.axial_section_shape: human trunk with a fuller lower abdomen

V05.drivers: Ordinary human; somewhat wider hips and thighs than the others.

non_structural_factors.notes: a little softer through the hips

V07.drivers: Ordinary human with a rounded belly and fuller torso in profile.

structure.axial_section_shape: human trunk with a fuller abdomen

V08.drivers: Very deep, keel-like upper chest that bulges strongly front and back in profile, over a pinched waist and narrow pelvis. Long, thin limbs with prominent knobby elbows and knees. The profile shows an S-shaped trunk-to-leg line, with the knee set behind the thigh line. Squared, narrow shoulders and long hands.
limb_cues: long thin arms with angular elbows
knobby knees with stepped thigh-to-shin transition

structure.axial_section_shape: deep keel chest over a narrow waist and small pelvis; rhomboid in profile
structure.joint_integration: angular, knobby joints that sit as discrete nodes rather than smooth transitions
structure.segment_relations: long slender legs and arms relative to a compact chest; long hands
structure.load_path: weight carried by the forward chest mass, with an offset S-line down through a narrow pelvis to the feet

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness is present, but the chest and joint organization drives the read

V10.drivers: Massive, armor-like plated musculature. Huge shoulder and trapezius masses with the neck sunk between them. Short, bowed, heavily segmented legs with a bent-knee stance and big blocky feet. Thick forearms and large hands. In profile the back is hunched and the legs zig-zag. A detached fragment beside the profile looks like a tail or appendage, or a model artifact.
axial_cues: wide rib cage with ridged abdomen

structure.axial_section_shape: very wide inverted-trapezoid chest; deep and hunched in profile
structure.joint_integration: joints buried under bulging muscle masses; stepped, lumpy transitions
structure.segment_relations: short legs relative to a huge upper body; arms long and heavy; large hands and feet
structure.load_path: weight thrown forward from a hunched upper mass through flexed, bowed legs

non_structural_factors.notes: extreme muscle, but the hunch, bowed legs and segment ratios go beyond human variation

V11.drivers: Nearly identical organization to V08: deep keel-like chest bulging front and back, pinched waist, narrow pelvis, long thin limbs with knobby knees and elbows, long hands, and an S-line profile.

structure.axial_section_shape: deep keel chest over a narrow waist; rhomboid in profile
structure.segment_relations: long slender limbs relative to a compact trunk
structure.load_path: forward chest mass with an offset S-line down to the feet

non_structural_factors.notes: a slender build, but the chest shape drives the read

distinguishing_features: V08/V11 are slender, with a deep keel chest, pinched waist, narrow pelvis, long thin limbs, knobby joints and an upright S-line profile. V10 is enormously bulky, with plated muscle masses, a hunched back, short bowed bent-knee legs, and large hands and feet. They differ in trunk section shape, segment ratios and load path, not just in bulk.
